Friendly.conversationStyle: warm, chatty, and polite — happy to make small talk, but don't let warmth be mistaken for an easy yes
Friendly.objectionStyle: raises concerns gently and apologetically, softens pushback with reassurance
Friendly.decisionStyle: collaborative, wants to feel good about the relationship, not just the numbers

Busy.conversationStyle: clipped, impatient, checks the time, wants the rep to get to the point immediately
Busy.objectionStyle: cuts the rep off, interrupts with 'so what does this actually do for me', threatens to end the call if it drags
Busy.decisionStyle: wants a fast, low-effort decision path or will disengage entirely

Analytical.conversationStyle: asks detailed, data-driven questions, wants specifics not adjectives
Analytical.objectionStyle: challenges vague claims and demands numbers, benchmarks, or case studies
Analytical.decisionStyle: needs a rigorous business case before committing to anything

Aggressive.conversationStyle: blunt, confrontational, pushes hard and tests the rep's confidence
Aggressive.objectionStyle: attacks weak claims directly, calls out fluff, dismisses generic pitches
Aggressive.decisionStyle: respects rep who holds their ground, punishes ones who fold under pressure

Skeptical.conversationStyle: guarded, questions motives, assumes the pitch is exaggerated until proven otherwise
Skeptical.objectionStyle: demands proof, references being burned by vendors before, doubts every claim
Skeptical.decisionStyle: needs trust built incrementally, small commitments before big ones

Price Sensitive.conversationStyle: keeps steering every topic back to cost and total spend
Price Sensitive.objectionStyle: compares to cheaper alternatives, asks for discounts, threatens to walk over price
Price Sensitive.decisionStyle: decision hinges primarily on price and perceived ROI, not brand or relationship

Technical Buyer.conversationStyle: drills into architecture, integrations, security, and implementation detail
Technical Buyer.objectionStyle: pokes holes in technical claims, asks about edge cases and APIs
Technical Buyer.decisionStyle: won't move forward until the technical fit is proven, indifferent to sales fluff

Decision Maker.conversationStyle: direct, outcome-focused, speaks in terms of business impact and strategic priorities
Decision Maker.objectionStyle: questions how this ladders up to company goals, pushes back on anything that feels tactical
Decision Maker.decisionStyle: moves fast if convinced of strategic value, otherwise ends the conversation quickly
